program='''def transform(grid):
    # The rare non-zero color is the example shape; copy its occupied cells
    # onto every all-zero placement of that shape.
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh = max(dr for dr, dc in shape) + 1
    sw = max(dc for dr, dc in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[y][x] == 0 for y, x in cells):
                for y, x in cells:
                    out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
